messages:
maria: Quick sync — planning to flip three runtime flags together for a small canary today: flash_attn_v2=on, spec_decode_v2=on, kv_cache_prefetch=0.75. Want opinions on audience + guardrails.

alex: I can do 5% US-WEST first. keep EU off. confirm we have fallback to spec_decode_v1 if decode diverges? :thinking: 

maria: yep fallback exists. config name: runtime.ff.multi_opt_combo. Will set rollout to 5% -> 20% over 2 hours if metrics OK.

kai: need to validate correctness with our hallucination regression set. Can you point to the eval set and the job id? I'll run a quick diff.

maria: eval job is `eval/2026-03-17/opt_combo_smoke`. baseline vs combo: run id 20260317-02.

jess: add a regression guard: if 'response_quality_drop_pct' > 0.8% OR 'avg_latency_p90' > +30ms, rollback automatically. Ops can we wire that to the deployer? @ops-bot

ops-bot: @channel noted. I can add those guardrails. Need the metric names and alert thresholds. Provide them and I’ll attach to the rollout policy.

alex: metric names: `quality.regression_pct` and `latency.p90_ms`. thresholds: quality > 0.8, p90_delta > 30. Also please watch token-usage variance.

maria: adding to rollout plan. Will enable logs sampling at 10% for the canary to capture traces for failed requests.

kai: Running the hallucination eval now. quick note: speculative decode sometimes changes early termination behavior; ensure we compare tokens-normalized metrics.

maria: good call. we'll normalize by returned_token_count in eval.

jess: also flagging AB test ID: ab:opt_combo_20260317. analytics: split by model_revision and region.

alex: small PR up for the flag config: https://git.redwood.dev/r/redwood/runtime/+/PR-5234 — contains the audience sharding to us-west-1a/b. PTAL @kai @jess

kai: reviewing now. two quick comments inline about the default kv prefetch param.

maria: timeline: aiming to start canary at 16:30 UTC. I will post a one-line status at start/15m/30m/60m. If nothing bad, ramp to 20% at +2h.

jess: QA: I'll run a small prod-like job against canary with 500 prompts to sanity-check outputs. Will report by +30m.

ops-bot: guardrails attached to rollout: {"quality.regression_pct":0.8, "latency.p90_ms":30, "error_rate":0.5}. Automatic rollback enabled.

deploy-bot: Scheduled rollout: runtime.ff.multi_opt_combo -> 5% us-west (shard us-west-1*) at 1943219400 (16:30 UTC). Canaries monitored by /metrics/runtime/opt_combo.

alex: couple of operational notes: for anyone oncall, if you see a spike in `cache.evictions` it might indicate kv prefetch is too aggressive. We have hotfix knob `kv_prefetch_ratio` to dial back.

maria: thanks — I'll be online for the rollout. ping me directly if you see anything odd.

kai: eval finished: small quality delta +0.4% (within guardrail), latency p90 improved by 18ms. I'll paste diff summary in a sec.

kai: diff summary: "hallucination_rate: +0.37%, p95_latency: -18ms, token_retention_change: -0.2%". Looks safe at 5%.

jess: QA passed initial 500 prompts, no obvious regressions. one case of slight truncation for very long context; filing bug #RM-842. Not critical for canary.

maria: ok let's proceed with 5% start. I'll post updates.

alex: ack. will stand by for rollback test if needed. :thumbsup:

maria: (16:30) starting canary. runtime.ff.multi_opt_combo -> 5% us-west.

maria: (16:45) status: metrics stable. quality.regression_pct=0.21, latency.p90_ms_delta=-10. enabling 2x logs for flagged requests.

jess: (17:00) QA green. ramp to 20% in 10m?

kai: agree. +10m seems fine if metrics stay.

maria: ramping to 20% now.

deploy-bot: Rollout update: 5% -> 20% complete at 1943220200. Monitoring continues.

ops-bot: guardrail check passed at +30m and +90m. No auto-rollback triggered.

maria: final note: keep the flag in canary for 24h, then we'll schedule a second cohort with EU if no issues. Thanks all. :rocket:
